Fit a seasonal trajectory and extract phenological metrics

cl_pheno_fit.Rd

Fits a double-logistic curve or a smoothing spline to the observations, and extracts the start and end of season as the days on which the fitted curve crosses threshold of its amplitude before and after the peak.

For the double logistic, the position of the season is located before the nonlinear fit. With the transition dates and rates held fixed, the model is linear in base and amplitude, so every candidate pair of start and end dates on a five-day grid has a closed-form least-squares fit. The pair with the smallest residual sum of squares starts the optimiser. If that fit does not converge, the best pair at a start date at least 30 days away is tried, and then sos = 110, eos = 290. The first converged fit is returned.

Usage

cl_pheno_fit(doy, value, model = c("dbl_logistic", "spline"), threshold =
  0.5, start = NULL)

Arguments

doy

Day of year of each observation.

value

Observed index values.

model

"dbl_logistic" or "spline".

threshold

Amplitude fraction defining SOS and EOS for the threshold extraction, following common practice.

start

Optional named list of starting values for the double logistic, with elements base, amplitude, sos, eos, slope_up and slope_down in any order. Values outside the parameter bounds are moved to the nearest bound. When NULL (the default), starting values are derived from the data, as described above.

Value

A list with sos, eos, los, peak_doy, peak_value, converged and fit.
